title: Austin Awards Airport Runway Project
summary:
*   A special meeting was held to decide on bids for new runway and taxiway extensions at Robert Mueller Airport.
*   One company unexpectedly withdrew its bid for the airport project during the session.
*   The contract for the crucial airport expansion was then awarded to Schwope Brothers, determined to be the lowest and best remaining bid.
